statement: SK Hynix began mass production of HBM4 in Q2 2026 and has started sample shipments of HBM4E, with capital spending planned in the high 40 trillion won range this year.
why: HBM is the gating input for AI accelerators, so a next-generation ramp plus heavy memory capex expands the supply ceiling for GPU shipments.

impact.mechanism: Mass production of HBM4 plus large memory capex raises bit supply available to accelerator makers, loosening a key bottleneck.

evidence.excerpt: The company began mass production of HBM4 in Q2 2026 and has commenced sample shipments of the subsequent HBM4E generation.

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet summarizing company results; no filing fetched.
